item.title: Indiana Extends Medicaid Open Enrollment Through Dec. 24
item.description: Indiana health officials have extended open enrollment for two major Medicaid programs — the Healthy Indiana Plan (HIP) and PathWays for Aging — through Dec. 24, giving Hoosiers more time to choose a new managed care plan.
